head: a8c31a842b233ebc5c3a0c95ebe93d7203fcf537
scope: Complete three-file lower unit plus actual facade, sanitizer and recorded renamed native proof. No Schedule consumer or whole stack approval.

source_review.detail: Both public encoders invoke Safe_ops.sanitize_json_utf8 once and use the same private compact writer. The new result tuple holds the exact repaired immutable AST supplied to that writer. Old API returns only private encoded_json and does not retain the AST.

Yojson.Json_error from compact writer remains Error message, without catch-all/defaulting. Current sanitizer performs UTF8/control-byte repair and immutable traversal only; it makes no Yojson writer/parser/error call. Thus moving sanitization to the helper call argument does not remove a currently reachable sanitizer Json_error conversion. Other exceptions remain exceptional as before.

encoded_json remains private string; helper is not exported. New API describes writer-input AST, does not claim readback, write success, parse canonicalization, or domain validation. Facade include exposes new symbol automatically without losing private type identity.

Sanitizer preserves immutable strings/nodes when unchanged, reconstructs changed lists/objects in order and leaves numeric variants unchanged. Duplicate fields and negative zero are not newly normalized. No new global cache, lazy work, worker/promise, mutable encoded buffer or retained closure is added.

New finite case exercises invalid UTF8 in keys/values, forbidden control byte repair, Unicode/newline/tab, duplicate fields, order and negative zero; asserts exact writer bytes and returned AST. Non-finite cases assert both old/new APIs return identical errors. Backend.error change enumerates remaining three constructors after existing NotFound branch, preserving failure behavior and closing fatal warning4.

memory_retention: Only callers of the new API retain the AST explicitly beside the encoded string. Valid input can be the same physical AST returned by sanitizer; repaired branches can be shared with original immutable subgraphs. Old API has no added owner/cache; new tuple/map closure dies with the immediate result unless caller keeps it. No runtime RSS/allocation improvement or measured retention bound was established in this review.
consumer_boundary: Returned AST is the compact writer input, not a universal substitute for parsing encoded bytes. Intlit and parser numeric normalization can differ after a wire roundtrip; consumer-specific generated value and domain decoder semantics must be reviewed in upper layer. No lower API defect because MLI states this boundary.

native_evidence.prior_failures: r1 failed at existing Backend.error wildcard warning4; corrected closed match is in reviewed source. First r2 binary basename selected production policy and failed10 test-mode-sensitive checks; same bytes renamed to actual test basename under owned temp passed60. Both failures remain retained, no product base-path bypass added.
native_evidence.limits: Six complete source compile commands (Ops MLI/ML, Facade MLI/ML, empty test wrapper MLI and complete coverage ML) use existing compatible prebuilt dependencies and renamed units. Two prior scratch include dirs also occur; listed CMIs there do not replace the reviewed Ops/Facade. This is not a whole-source-head Dune/CI/production build. Reviewer read records and binaries; reviewer did not rerun the compiler or test.

mutations: Only this private review JSON and reviewed-diff evidence were written. No Git ref/index/product source/runtime/GitHub changes.
